title: Tex-Mex Pasta Salad
description: A macaroni salad with black beans, sweetcorn and red pepper, tossed in a smoky, zesty jalapeño and lime dressing.
ingredients: 400g (14oz) can of black beans, drained and rinsed
1 red pepper, deseeded and finely chopped
large handful of coriander leaves, finely chopped
DRESSING: 2 tbsp fat-free Greek yogurt, 1 garlic clove crushed, 1/2 tsp smoked paprika, 2 tbsp finely chopped jalapeños, juice of 1 lime, pepper
steps: Bring a large pan of water to the boil and add 2 teaspoons of salt. Pour in the macaroni and simmer fast for 5 minutes.
Add the black beans and sweetcorn and simmer for another 5 minutes, or until the pasta is cooked.
Drain the pasta, beans and sweetcorn and give it a quick rinse under cold water. Drain very well. Place in a serving bowl and stir in the pepper, spring onions and coriander.
Make up the dressing by stirring all the ingredients vigorously. Add it to the salad, season well, then stir to combine everything. Serve warm or cold.
notes: Substitute black beans for pinto beans, use different pasta shapes, or add extra vegetables such as avocado, red onion, green beans or baby tomatoes. Adjust jalapeños to taste.
